QuantrolOx and QURECA Partner to Launch Quantum EDGE Academy for Hands-On Hardware Training

Quantum measurement and control software developer QuantrolOx (Espoo, Finland / Oxford, UK) has partnered with quantum education provider QURECA (Glasgow, UK) to launch the Quantum EDGE Academy. Integrated into QURECA’s educational catalog, the initiative provides a flight-simulator-style software environment to train experimentalists, technicians, and hardware engineers in automated QPU development, tuning, qubit characterization, and system operation.

Addressing the Hardware Engineering Bottleneck

While theoretical quantum education has expanded globally, industrial hardware developers face a critical shortage of experimentalists qualified to operate dilution refrigerators, measure physical qubits, and tune multi-qubit processors. The Quantum EDGE Academy addresses this gap by training students and technicians using the exact automated measurement and control workflows deployed by QuantrolOx engineers on live operational QPUs:

Realistic Flight-Simulator Environment: The academy allows learners to build practical laboratory intuition, execute tuning sequences, and troubleshoot setup errors without requiring immediate access to scarce physical dilution refrigerators or risking damage to delicate quantum hardware.

CPD Accreditation and Institutional Delivery: Courses carry Continuing Professional Development (CPD) certification through QURECA. The curriculum is structured for flexible institutional adoption, utilizing per-seat cohort pricing and departmental subscriptions for universities, national laboratories, and corporate R&D teams.

Progression to Physical Systems: For institutions expanding beyond simulation, the academy acts as a training stepping stone toward hands-on operation on real hardware, such as QuantrolOx’s VIDYAQAR—an open-architecture, integrated superconducting quantum system designed for education, testing, and research.

Enrolment for the initial pilot cohort opens in September 2026 for academic institutions, government facilities, and industry partners.
